To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the quality of life in a sample of Portuguese children and youth was adequate.

(a) the quality of life in the sample was good, (b) there were no differences in the quality of the life of children from urban and rural areas, and from the coastal area and the interior, (c) the younger children had a lower family quality of life, and (d) the quality of the children's life was related to the children's body mass index and their health perception.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quality of life in children and youth.
the quality of life in children and youth and its consequences for socio- educational interventions.
the quality of life in children and youth and its determinants, in order to define guidelines for socio-educative intervention.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quality of life is a construct that is perceived differently according to age, gender, place of residence, body mass index and perceived state of health.

the study of the quality of life in children and youth allows the identification of factors of relevance in the well-being of different groups, which will allow the definition and implementation of socio-educative intervention guidelines adjusted to their specificities.
the study has provided a comprehensive and detailed analysis of the determinants of quality of life in children and youth, and the consequences for socioeducational practice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that there is a need for further research on the impact of the environment on the health and well-being of children and adolescents.
we found encouraging levels of quality of live in the Portuguese children and youth.
we are trying to understand the determinants of quality of life in children and youth and their consequences for social and educational intervention.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of life in children and adolescents is generally high.
the quality of life in the youngest is adequate and that the variables studied are not associated with the quality of life.
quality of life of Portuguese children and youth is generally high, although there are differences between groups, which should be taken into account in socio-educational interventions.
